description: Single-V SAW butt weld on an AH36 panel. Golden values regenerated after the Rosenthal unit fix (temperature rise in K adds directly to the C preheat; arc efficiency eta=0.95 now applied to the net plate power) and verified against an independent implementation: t8/5 matches the closed-form 3D Rykalin expression Q/(2*pi*k*v)*(1/(500-T0)-1/(800-T0)) = 29.08 s, the thermal-cycle peak matches a direct scan of the analytic Rosenthal field (9605 C at xi = -10.9 mm; the sampled 9578.6 C is the 401-sample discretisation), and the contraction-model values were recomputed by hand. Experimental ranges for comparable single-side V butts: transverse shrinkage 0.5-2.5 mm, angular distortion 0.5-4 deg. Longitudinal shrinkage and bowing regenerated for the panel-parameterized model (panel section = panel_width x thickness = 2000x12 mm instead of a hard-coded 1000 mm reference; bow arm = panel_width/4), hand-verified: longitudinal = 12e-6 * 1125.37 * (63.735/24000) * 1000 = 0.03586 mm, bow = 0.03586 * 6 / 500 = 0.00043 mm.

tolerance.note: computed values must match expected within +/-5% relative (t8/5 within 10%: sample discretisation)
